description: Procurement of Coal for Lakvijaya Power Plant, Norochcholai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2026-03-30, granted approval to procure 2.28 million (±10%) MT of Coal for Lakvijaya Power Plant, Norochcholai during the period of 2026/2027. Further, the National Procurement Commission has granted concurrence to select two coal suppliers per one coal supply season enabling to ensure the energy security in the country by avoiding the risk of disturbances to the supply. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the international competitive bidding procedure and 09 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said procurement as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
